name: Eratosthenes Scholasticus
bio: Eratosthenes Scholasticus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Cycle of Agathias, the sixth-century anthology.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 444).

poems.title: Book IX, 444
poems.author: Eratosthenes Scholasticus
poems.text: Fair are the treasures of virginity, but if it were observed by all it would put an end to life. Therefore live in lawful wedlock, and give a mortal to the world to replace thee ; but avoid lechery.
